name: AnimationClip
signature: public sealed class AnimationClip : Asset, ISerializable

docs.summary: An animation clip: the encoded Motion clip, the rig it was authored on, and its settings.
The rig the clip was authored on. A humanoid clip uses it only to preview.
Whether playback wraps or holds the final pose.
The clip's name in the file it was imported from, which its import settings are keyed on.
The clip's markers, handed to Motion when the clip is decoded.
Where in the take the clip starts, in seconds, as the import cut it.
Clip length in seconds, readable without decoding the payload.
The clip Motion plays, decoded on first use and bound to `target` when humanoid. Null while a skeletal clip's rig is still loading, or when the payload is missing.
Drops the decoded clip, so the next use picks up the current events.
